name: High Jinx!
source:
Tony's life is pretty rotten... until he stumbles upon a genie living inside a magic lava-lamp that can change his bad luck (and possibly change a lot else as well).

[From [url=https://www.tfgamessite.com/?module=viewgame&id=1241]TF Games Site[/url]]
translation:
托尼的生活相当糟糕……直到他偶然发现一个住在魔法熔岩灯里的精灵，它可以改变他的厄运（也可能改变很多其他事情）。

[来自[url=https://www.tfgamessite.com/?module=viewgame&id=1241]TF Games网站[/url]]
